sections.heading: What Is Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services?
paragraphs: Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services serves businesses across Nigeria. We are built to solve one specific problem: getting Nigerian businesses and homes the right person, fast, and affordably. We maintain a verified community of ready-to-work candidates, from entry-level graduates to experienced professionals, so that when you need staff, you are not starting from zero, you are choosing from people who are already screened and available.
Find & Review Us on Google

sections.heading: Who We Work With
sections.sub: We are built for the businesses and households that need staff without the overhead of a full HR department.

entries.title: Small & Growing Businesses
entries.text: From single-location shops to multi-branch operations that need to hire quickly and repeatedly.

entries.title: Private Individuals & Homes
entries.text: As a domestic staff recruitment agency in Abuja and across Nigeria, we place housekeepers, cooks, drivers, and personal staff that families and individuals can trust.

entries.title: Large Corporations
entries.text: Established companies that need high-volume or specialist hiring handled quickly, from entry-level roles to senior appointments, without stretching their internal HR team.

sections.heading: Graduate Recruitment & Mass Training
sections.sub: Two of the most common reasons businesses come to Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services.

entries.title: Graduate Recruitment
entries.text: We source and place graduate talent for entry-level and junior roles across Nigeria, matched to the specific skills your business needs rather than a generic CV pool. A practical option if you are asking where to train graduates in Nigeria or Abuja.

entries.title: Mass Recruitment & Training
entries.text: For businesses hiring in bulk, Plan A supports mass recruitment with unlimited candidate requests, while Plan C includes structured onboarding and skills training delivered by our management consultants, built for mass training initiatives in Nigeria.

sections.heading: What We Recruit For
sections.sub: If it involves people showing up and doing the job well, we have likely staffed it.

sections.heading: Why Abuja Businesses Choose Our Affordable Staffing Services

entries.title: Fast Turnaround

entries.title: Professional & Vetted

entries.title: 24/7 Customer Support
entries.text: Our team is reachable around the clock, so a staffing emergency never has to wait until Monday morning.

entries.title: Affordable Pricing
entries.text: Plans starting from ₦30,000, built to keep quality staffing accessible for small businesses and homes across Abuja.

sections.heading: Our Recruitment Plans
sections.sub: Three ways to work with us, depending on how often you hire and what kind of role you are filling.

entries.title: Plan A — High-Volume Staffing
entries.text:
Tailored search and selection services designed to fill core operational roles with precision. This tier provides direct access to our verified community professionals, ensuring cultural fit and technical competence.

Ideal for roles with high attrition rates or rapid scaling needs in industries like Sales, Hospitality, Construction, FinTechs, Technology, Industries, FMCG, ad-hoc staffing, homes, private staff, and more.

✓ Unlimited candidate requests
✓ First time waiting period of 1 month
✓ Best for roles with high attrition rates
✓ Just 24-48 hours waiting period during subscription
✓ Available in all states in Nigeria

entries.title: Plan B — Specialized Talent Search
entries.text:
A highly strategic, comprehensive recruitment service dedicated to sourcing specialized talent and leadership roles across various Nigerian states and international markets.

Best for companies that usually need one staff member at a time, with a very low attrition rate.

✓ Candidate sourcing
✓ Candidate selection
✓ Pre-interview advisory
✓ Save time wasted on vacancy ads
✓ Save time wasted on sourcing through CVs
✓ Save time wasted on pre-interview screening
✓ One-off service
✓ Qualified candidates in 2 weeks or less
✓ Available in all states in Nigeria

entries.title: Plan C — End-to-End Executive HR Partnership
entries.text:
A fully managed, consultant-led recruitment process from initial sourcing through to corporate integration.

Best for organizations seeking a complete corporate onboarding experience, expert interview panels, and post-hire development.

✓ First-level interviewing with a Traction Outsourcing HR professional
✓ Second-level joint panel interviews with Traction Outsourcing HR professional and your management
✓ Full HR compliance support, including standardized staff offer letters, tailored job descriptions, and optional staff background check
✓ Includes 2 standardized trainings delivered by our management consultants (1 general staff training and 1 corporate onboarding training)
✓ Minimum of 5 recruited staff for this plan

entries.title: Home Plan — Home Recruitment
entries.text:
Specially designed for homeowners who need to recruit domestic staff once, without ongoing management. We find the right person, hand them over, and you take full control from there.

Best for homeowners recruiting domestic staff: nannies, cooks, cleaners, drivers, gardeners, security, and other home-based roles.

✓ One-off recruitment service
✓ Candidate sourcing from verified community
✓ Skills and background screening
✓ Hands-off after placement, you manage your own home staff
✓ Free one-time replacement within the first month
✓ Single, one-time fee. No recurring charges
✓ No staff management included
✓ Available across Nigeria

entries.q: Is Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services the same as ATH Recruiters or Abuja Talent Hub?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services was previously known as ATH Recruiters, and Abuja Talent Hub is the name of its community of verified, ready-to-work candidates. It now runs directly under Traction Outsourcing Limited, with the same community and the same recruitment service.

entries.q: Is Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services an affordable recruitment agency in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services is built to be one of the more affordable recruitment agencies in Nigeria, with plans starting from ₦30,000 for select roles, keeping pricing accessible for small businesses and private individuals, not just large corporations.

entries.q: Is Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services a domestic staff recruitment agency in Nigeria?
entries.a: Yes. Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services works as a domestic staff recruitment agency in Abuja and across Nigeria, placing housekeepers, cooks, drivers, nannies, and other personal staff for private homes and individuals who need people they can trust.

entries.q: How fast can Traction Outsourcing Recruitment Services fill a role?
entries.a: Turnaround depends on the plan. Plan A offers a 24 to 48 hour turnaround for subscribers, Plan B typically delivers qualified candidates within 2 weeks for specialised roles, and Plan C is a fully managed process suited to leadership and bulk hires.
